exponent_encoding: nonnegative bounded JSON integers, in variables order

validation.method: independent helper formula/point enumeration, full sparse-equation domain re-evaluation, and runtime reference signed-point/subgroup checks

boundaries: This separate extension adds field coverage to the original 55-case complexity battery.
The 14 cases are deliberate small two-point fixtures, not an unbiased relation-yield sample or complete ECDLP attack.
Golden truths are supplied for post-solve conformance; they are not solver roots.
Generation and validation do not measure Groebner solving or degree of regularity.
The original 55-case catalog and existing benchmark results are unchanged.

endomorphism.proof_method: Degree-two Koblitz Frobenius has fundamental -7 discriminant.

generator_selection.generator_rule: ascending canonical x integers; min y; first nonzero [d2/r]P of order r

factor_base.membership_policy: on curve and in the selected rank-one rational prime-order subgroup; both signs allowed
factor_base.sampling_note: Deliberately includes x(G),x([2]G); not an unbiased factor-base or relation-yield sample

target.sampling_method: Sum of two explicitly retained factor-base points

generation.method: Independent binary polynomial arithmetic and affine ECC; exact finite factor-base enumeration
generation.membership_filter_note: Additional Boolean truth-table equations restrict x to actual selected-subgroup points; their degree is not the degree of Semaev f3
generation.truth_method: Exhaustive selected factor-base x-pair f3 evaluation, independently matched to signed point-pair sums
generation.claims: Small two-point fixture only; no higher-arity relation or cryptographic hardness estimate

endomorphism.proof_method: f_pi=62. Full rational 2-torsion proves (pi-1)/2 is an endomorphism, excluding factor2 from f_E. For ell=31, trace/2=-1 mod31 and x^p=x modulo the degree480 division polynomial psi_31, so Frobenius acts as [-1] on E[31]. Thus (pi+1)/31 is an endomorphism, excluding factor31. Consequently f_E=1.

generator_selection.R_rule: first scanned point of exact order d2
generator_selection.rule: x ascending from zero; minimum integer square root

twist.representative_point_map: direct twist (x,y) -> partner (x/scale^2,y/scale^3); infinity maps to infinity

generation.method: deterministic kG factor base and finite exhaustive verification
generation.factor_base_rule: x(kG) for k=1..size; both point signs permitted
generation.target_method: sum of first two positive kG points
